regler.tekst: Here comes the wave! You take a sip first, then the person on your left – and so on, all the way round the ring.
regler.kort: One sip each, all the way round.

regler.tekst: Hand out two sips. Give both to one person, or one each to two different people.
Pick someone to cheers with. Look each other in the eye, say ‘cheers’ and take a sip each.
Everyone point a finger at the sky – now! The last one to do it takes a sip.
regler.kort: Last finger in the air takes a sip.

regler.tekst: You're the thumb master! When you put your thumb on the edge of the table, everyone has to do the same. The last one takes a sip. Lasts until the next five.
regler.kort: Last thumb on the table takes a sip.

regler.tekst: Your neighbours on either side cheers each other – right under your nose – and take a sip each.
Say something you have never done: ‘Never have I ever …’. Everyone who HAS done it takes a sip.
regler.kort: Everyone who has done it takes a sip.

regler.tekst: Pick a mate. Every time one of you takes a sip, the other one does too. Lasts until the next eight.
regler.kort: You drink together until the next eight.

regler.tekst: Say a word. Go round the ring: everyone says a word that rhymes. Whoever gets stuck or repeats a word takes a sip.
Pick a category. Go round the ring: everyone names one thing that fits. Whoever gets stuck or repeats one takes a sip.
regler.kort: Name things in a category, round the ring.

regler.tekst: Make a rule that lasts for the rest of the game. Whoever breaks it takes a sip.
You're the question master until the next queen. Anyone who answers a question from you takes a sip. Answer with another question and you get away with it.
regler.kort: Whoever answers you takes a sip.

regler.tekst: Think of something the whole crew will toast to in the finale, and say it out loud. The fourth king ends the ring.
regler.kort: Make a toast for the finale. Fourth king: finale!

finale.tekst: The fourth king has been drawn! Everyone stands up and raises their glass. You read the toasts out loud – and then everyone takes one sip together.
finale.tidlig: You're taking the finale now! Everyone stands up and raises their glass. You read the toasts out loud – and then everyone takes one sip together.

regel: Everyone must cheers with their left hand.
Nobody may say ‘yes’ or ‘no’.
Nobody may say names – use nicknames instead.
Say ‘cheers’ in another language before you drink.
Everyone must call each other ‘captain’.
No pointing – use your elbow.
Nobody may say ‘drink’ – say ‘sip’ instead.
Nobody may say ‘I’ – say ‘this person’ instead.
No swearing – say ‘fiddlesticks’ instead.
Whoever gets their phone out takes a sip.
Talk like a newsreader when you draw a card.
No saying numbers – show them with your fingers.
Everyone must say ‘thank you, card’ when they draw.
Draw your card with your little finger.
Everyone applauds whoever draws.
Smile without showing your teeth.
Stand on one leg when you draw a card.
Say ‘sorry’ to your glass before you drink.
Nobody may say ‘phone’ – say ‘pocket gadget’ instead.
Hold your glass with both hands, like a teacup.
Everyone must call whoever last drew a king ‘Your Majesty’.
Guess your card out loud before you draw.
Whoever draws a queen swaps seats with their neighbour.
Nobody may cross their arms.
When someone says ‘cheers’, everyone answers ‘and cheers to you!’
Say the name of an animal before you drink.
Nobody may say ‘actually’.
Everyone nods solemnly when someone draws a king.
Whoever laughs at their own joke takes a sip.
Nobody may touch their glass with their right hand.
Nobody may say ‘card’ – say ‘paper square’ instead.
Whoever draws must do a little dance first.
Everyone must whisper to the question master.
Nobody may say ‘okay’.
Say ‘thank you so much’ every time someone gives you a sip.
Nobody may say ‘like’.
Whoever draws must say a rhyme first.
Everyone claps once whenever someone says a number.
Nobody may say ‘maybe’.
Salute before you draw.
Whoever says ‘sorry’ must say it in three languages.
Nobody may say ‘mm’ – answer with words.
Whoever draws must pay someone a compliment first.
Everyone says ‘the card has spoken!’ after every draw.
Everyone claps twice when someone says ‘cheers’.
Nobody may say ‘party’ – say ‘gathering’ instead.
Cheers with an animal noise.
Nobody may say ‘good’ – find another word.
Everyone must call water ‘mountain spring gold’.
Interrupt someone and you must apologise in rhyme.
Whoever forgets a rule takes a sip of water.
Everyone must say ‘delightful’ about everything they taste.
Everyone must call their glass ‘the trophy’.
Thumbs up before you draw.
Whoever draws an ace picks the next song.
Nobody may say ‘ring’ – say ‘circle’ instead.
No elbows on the table.
Whoever draws must say one thing they like about their neighbour.
Everyone must call the cards ‘the treasure chest’.
Use your poshest voice when you talk to the host.
